mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.COMPANY_CODE, U.DIVISION_CODE, get_company_name(U.COMPANY_CODE, U.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE) AS COMPANY_NAME, U.DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN U.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE = 'KOR' THEN U.NAME_KOR ELSE U.NAME_ENG END AS USER_NAME, U.USER_AUTH, U.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, COALESCE(U.WORK_YYYY_MM, TO_CHAR(now(), 'YYYYMM')) AS WORK_YYYY_MM FROM USER_INFO U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{USERID} AND U.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND U.STATUS = 'Y' AND U.PASSWORD = LOWER(#{ENC_PASSWORD})

WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.sort_no) AS sort_no, 1 AS depth, m.menu_id AS id, CASE 'KOR' WHEN 'KOR' THEN m.menu_name WHEN 'ENG' THEN m.menu_name_eng WHEN 'LOC' THEN m.menu_name_loc ELSE m.menu_name_loc END AS text, m.parent_menu_id AS parent_id, CASE 'KOR' WHEN 'KOR' THEN sm.menu_name WHEN 'ENG' THEN sm.menu_name_eng WHEN 'LOC' THEN sm.menu_name_loc ELSE sm.menu_name_loc END AS parent_menu_name, m.menu_desc, m.menu_type, COALESCE(m.link_url, '#') as link_url, m.using_yn FROM menu m LEFT JOIN menu sm ON m.parent_menu_id = sm.menu_id WHERE m.parent_menu_id IS NULL AND m.using_yn = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY child.sort_no), parent.depth + 1, child.menu_id, CASE 'KOR' WHEN 'KOR' THEN child.menu_name WHEN 'ENG' THEN child.menu_name_eng WHEN 'LOC' THEN child.menu_name_loc ELSE child.menu_name_loc END, child.parent_menu_id, CASE 'KOR' WHEN 'KOR' THEN sm.menu_name WHEN 'ENG' THEN sm.menu_name_eng WHEN 'LOC' THEN sm.menu_name_loc ELSE sm.menu_name_loc END, child.menu_desc, child.menu_type, COALESCE(child.link_url, '#') as link_url, child.using_yn FROM menu child JOIN menu_tree parent ON child.parent_menu_id = parent.id LEFT JOIN menu sm ON child.parent_menu_id = sm.menu_id WHERE child.using_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT me.*, COALESCE(bm.menu_id, 'ENABLE_FAVORITE') AS favorite_yn FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT mt.*, u.user_id, u.company_code FROM user_info u INNER JOIN menu_tree mt ON mt.using_yn = 'Y' INNER JOIN role_user ru ON u.user_id = ru.user_id AND u.company_code = ru.company_code INNER JOIN role_menu rm ON ru.role_code = rm.role_code AND ru.company_code = rm.company_code AND rm.menu_id = mt.id WHERE u.user_id = #{USER_ID} AND u.company_code = #{COMPANY_CODE} ) me LEFT JOIN book_mark bm ON me.user_id = bm.user_id AND me.company_code = bm.company_code AND me.id = bm.menu_id ORDER BY sort_no;
SELECT A.USER_ID ,CASE WHEN A.LOGIN_FAIL_CNT > 4 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LOCK_YN ,A.EMAIL FROM COM_USER A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{S_USER_ID} AND A.USING_YN = 'Y' AND A.LOGIN_FAIL_CNT > 4
mapper.update: UPDATE COM_USER A SET A.LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = 0 ,A.LOGIN_FAIL_DATE = TO_DATE('19000101', 'YYYYMMDD') ,A.UNLOCK_STR = null WHERE A.USER_ID = #{S_USER_ID} AND A.UNLOCK_STR = #{LOCK_STR} AND A.USING_YN = 'Y'
UPDATE COM_USER A SET LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = (SELECT NVL(MAX(LOGIN_FAIL_CNT),0)+1 FROM COM_USER A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USERID}) , LOGIN_FAIL_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USERID}
UPDATE COM_USER A SET LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = 0 , LOGIN_FAIL_DATE = TO_DATE('19000101', 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USERID}
mapper.select: SELECT X_AXIS, THNG_SE, SUM(DRWBAK_AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.DRWBAK_MONTH, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYY-Q') || 'Q' AS X_AXIS, B.THNG_SE, A.DRWBAK_AMOUNT FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_CMMN A INNER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = B.DIVISION_CODE AND A.PRESENTN_NO = B.PRESENTN_NO WHERE 1=1 AND A.EXECUT_STATUS = '60' AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.DRWBAK_MONTH LIKE (SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(A.DRWBAK_MONTH), 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYY') FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_CMMN A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE}) || '%') GROUP BY X_AXIS, THNG_SE ORDER BY X_AXIS

SELECT NVL((SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(A.DRWBAK_MONTH), 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYYMM') FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_CMMN A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE}), '190001') AS DRWB_TARGET
FROM DUAL

SELECT A.DATA_NAME, A.X_AXIS, NVL(B.AMOUNT, A.AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM (SELECT B.DATA_NAME, A.X_AXIS, B.AMOUNT FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SDATE, LEVEL-1), 'YYYYMM') AS X_AXIS FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{DRWB_TARGET},'YYYYMM'), -11) , 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS SDATE, LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{DRWB_TARGET},'YYYYMM')) AS EDATE FROM DUAL) CONNECT BY LEVEL <= MONTHS_BETWEEN(EDATE+1, SDATE)) A INNER JOIN ( SELECT 'DRWB' AS DATA_NAME, 0 AS AMOUNT FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'CTRM_PART' AS DATA_NAME, 0 AS AMOUNT FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'CTRM_INIT' AS DATA_NAME, 0 AS AMOUNT FROM DUAL ) B ON 1=1) A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT 'DRWB' AS DATA_NAME , A.DRWBAK_MONTH AS X_AXIS ,SUM(A.DRWBAK_AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_CMMN A /* 발급대상만 수량 및 판매금액 계산 */ INNER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, PRESENTN_NO, SUM(ACCMLT_ORDER_QY) AS ISSUE_ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, SUM(STTEMNT_PC_KRW) AS ISSUE_STTEMNT_PC_KRW FROM (SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, PRESENTN_NO, XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, LNE_NO, POUCH_NO, ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, BASS_UNIT, STTEMNT_PC_KRW, THNG_SEQ FROM (SELECT T.COMPANY_CODE, T.DIVISION_CODE, T.PRESENTN_NO, T.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, T.LNE_NO, T.POUCH_NO, T.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, T.BASS_UNIT, TRUNC(T.STTEMNT_PC_KRW) AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW, T.THNG_SEQ, CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = A.BASS_UNIT THEN A.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END AS USGQTY FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG T INNER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL A ON T.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND T.PRESENTN_NO = A.PRESENTN_NO AND T.THNG_SEQ = A.THNG_SEQ INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO INNER JOIN IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM C ON A.COMPANY_CODE = C.COMPANY_CODE AND A.RAWMTRL_CODE = C.ITEM_CODE AND A.LNE_NO = C.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = C.POUCH_NO AND A.IMPDEC_NO = C.IMPDEC_NO WHERE TRUNC(A.CSTMS, 4) > 0 AND T.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE } AND T.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} ) X WHERE TRUNC(USGQTY, 3) > 0.000999999999999) GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, PRESENTN_NO) ISSUE ON A.COMPANY_CODE = ISSUE.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = ISSUE.DIVISION_CODE AND A.PRESENTN_NO = ISSUE.PRESENTN_NO WHERE A.DRWBAK_MONTH BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{DRWB_TARGET},'YYYYMM'), -11), 'YYYYMM') AND #{DRWB_TARGET} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE } AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.EXECUT_STATUS = '60'
GROUP BY A.DRWBAK_MONTH
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CTRM_INIT' AS DATA_NAME ,A.BASE_SOURCE_YYYYMM AS X_AXIS ,SUM(A.DRWBAK_AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM CTRM_CMMN A WHERE A.BASE_SOURCE_YYYYMM BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{DRWB_TARGET},'YYYYMM'), -11), 'YYYYMM') AND #{DRWB_TARGET} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE } AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.ISSUE_TYPE = '02' AND A.EXECUT_STATUS = '50' GROUP BY A.BASE_SOURCE_YYYYMM
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CTRM_PART' AS DATA_NAME ,A.BASE_SOURCE_YYYYMM AS X_AXIS ,SUM(A.DRWBAK_AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM CTRM_CMMN A WHERE A.BASE_SOURCE_YYYYMM BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{DRWB_TARGET},'YYYYMM'), -11), 'YYYYMM') AND #{DRWB_TARGET} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE } AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.ISSUE_TYPE = '04' AND A.EXECUT_STATUS = '50' GROUP BY A.BASE_SOURCE_YYYYMM ) B ON A.DATA_NAME = B.DATA_NAME AND A.X_AXIS = B.X_AXIS ORDER BY A.DATA_NAME, A.X_AXIS
